text:
Predicates:
Nazi(x) ::: x is a Nazi.
German(x) ::: x is German.
Politician(x) ::: x is a politician.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
StateParliament(x) ::: x is the Prussian State Parliament.
Reichstag(x) ::: x is the Nazi Reichstag.
Premises:
Nazi(heinrich) ∧ German(heinrich) ∧ Politician(heinrich) ::: Heinrich Scmidt was a Nazi German politician.
Member(heinrich, stateParliament) ∧ Member(heinrich, reichstag) ::: Heeinrich Scmidt was also a member of the Prussian State Parliament and the Nazi Reichstag.
Conclusion:
¬∃x (Politician(x) ∧ Member(x, reichstag)) ::: No politicans are part of the Nazi Reichstag.
